summary: The proof is correct and complete. If the full-selected-mass base set contained the center in its convex hull, the associated metronoid Minkowski sum would be a singleton; empty complete core and strict separation would then yield a balanced negative family on the two nonzero directions v and -v, contradicting minimum support cardinality three. Separating the center from that base set and applying the stated centerpoint and saturation inequalities gives G/W at least 1/(2^n+1). The accepted cap-mass bound and descendant-retention hypothesis give eta at most 3/5, and the remaining dimensional and n=4 bounds follow by valid algebra.
